book.name: Matiu
book.title: Matiu Gagalo euda Iesu Keriso umanawa Matiu girumalena

content: Nainai odawa gagalowa babawa
Iesu gagalo babawa da apana diamone wanase,
“God gonaawa ipa ema epe: Warere nolawa dewalala diamona me otopa baiwa nainai odawa imaasapu. Ita me oda sa baiwa apana nisou waaubaleno eteiena.
Oda walamawaida wiseno warere nolawa dewalala waaubamono antoiena nisolala diamopuo oda imaalene winedia bedewe wimopua baiwa. Tane mo oda bedewe awa dabuantone wankasanton.

Mo dabuantono baiwa warere oda dewasadia nolawa dewalala da waaubamona nisolala diamopue wapuase, ‘Sosona winlena, odana imaalene winede! Ne moiana kau eubuida bomone laulanteno imaantone wineia nata!’
Mo nisolala nisou osowe aleno etane oda bedewe awa dabuaidanton. Ita mo muba insaisau rua antoiena, dea iraiwa bedewe alen ita da gimara awa alen.
Tane nisolala isiwa dabuantone waimoie warere nolawa dewalala nisomopua awa mampo wimoieno wadaitumone kadikadimone epaboiamoiena.

Warere nolawa dewalala kadikadimoieno etene nuawa pokawaida wano me matangela mo osouwosapia baiwalene sorodiawa waaubamone diamone wanase, ‘Aitane, witakadilala sa uduudu epaboiamone ita mo bolau debamawa suno ipituwapi!’ Mo warere wana ruawantone antone witakadilala sa epaboiamone bolau suieno intuwan.
Ema aupe warere nolawa dewalala da diamone wanase, ‘Nainai odawa imaalene winede, tane mo nisolala kadiwaida oda awa wimopona dabuanton, mo dewau mai dodomana, dia, di nisokoamotana!
E tauma aitane bola uduudu bedewainta apana dommonuna nisomono oda bedewe wimopu.’
Ita nolawa dewalala me diamona rua bola uduudu bedewainta antone apana kadiwa ba euwa dommoia nisomone banlamone oda bedewe anton. Mo nisolala oda duwa bedewe odeieno apana uduudulen.
Warere nisolala auwamopia baiwa oda duwa bedewe odene alene auwamodie. Mo auwenatuwaiena bedeuwo apana dea mai nainai odawa garawa euda taupona wandio ewene
waitarasane wanase, ‘Sona, e ambi mape odaana? E mai nainai odawa garawa taupona, di wainiano eweedina.’ Warere apana sa waitarasadio dainalen, mai aia da wapona rua, dia.
Me dainakasaleno warere nolawa dewalala diamone wanase, ‘Apana ema wadane witapa ita wawa do taumone dubawa iwinla bedewe aubeno alepi. Sape me ke wampe poka etaidasampe asipa adompa.’”
Iesu gagalowa diasadie wanase, “Apana uaraia nisolala, tane mo bedeuwo isiwa os sonabalala.”
Gabeman manewa waitarawa
Parisi apanawa Iesu ene antone auwene gagalontone inta banusaie laga mampe Iesu waitarasampo wapikadisapio wadapua baiwa.

Sa baiwa Parisi sosou isiwa mo wauwo alala ita Erod sosowa isiwa do waaubamoieno antoiena Iesu mampe. Ita mo Iesu mampe wimone diane waienase, “Debamamba, no atenten e walama uduudu ulaipa os waeuwaitiana. E God insaisawa dodomana os apana waeuwamoiana, mai apana kerauda ita debama insaisau rua gagaloitipona.
E ambi inseiana, no ide rua Rom gabemaniwa mampe takis manewa ituta? E dianewo atentata!”
Tane mo kadiwa dima inseia Iesu atenlene baiwa diamone wanase, “E lagawaauida! Dima baiwa laga mampe waitaraneilana?
E mane sa nepa ambi rua malesaitilana euwaneano ewapa!” Mo mane sa wadane Iesu mampe wimoieno me ewene waitaramone wanase,
“Ewana, ema mida namba ita mida ebowa mane ema osowe winei?”
Mo leusane waienase, “Rom gabemaniwa ionoidoa namba ita ebowa winei.” Ita Iesu diamone wanase, “Ide, dima gabeman mampea gabeman wanana, tane dima God mampea ipa God wanana.”
Mo ema etane memesantone me ene antoiena.
Sadusi apanawa bolala enawisau waitarawantoi
Walama sa deawaawo Sadusi apanawa waitara do Iesu mampe wimoiena. Mo sumanaintoie inseia apana bolala ando mai bo bedewe enapuwimopue waimompa, dia.

Sa baiwa mo Iesu mampe wimone waienase, “Debamamba, Moses ema epe girumalene ituno winede: Apana mona nainaila obampasiawaia bolepio aupe apana sa wambaida tatawa obupa naisepie otootolepi tatawa baiwa. No menanedia anaana sa ipawaida atenidantata. Sa baiwa no duduna da dieeto etee waeuwanewo atentata.”
Mape mo dudunau Iesu diane waienase, “Apana wanwamba 6 bolauwo waimoie. Tautua dea nainailene obampasiawaia bolen. Tauma tautua wawea obu sa naisen.
Tane me mampe deawaa segalen, me do obampasiawaia bolen. Ita wambu natadeawa mampe deawaa segalen. Tane wanwambu ompu epe os dewantontuwan, mo uduudu i sa naiseiena ita obampusiawaia di bontoiena.
Ompa osowe obu sa do bolen.
I sa apana 7 naimono bontoiena. Sa baiwa no waeuwanewo atentata apana bolala bo bedewe enapuwimopue waimompo i sa apana dainea manainapaida wanalepi?”
Iesu mo sipoamone wanase, “Buka bedewe dima girumalena e mai inseipadewaitipe ita do God mukawa mai ateitipe wanleipona, dia. Sa baiwa waitarala surakauaia waile dianeilana.
Apana bolala bo bedewe enapuwimopue waimompaa walamawe mo mai nainaintopu, dia, mo ensel uboo waimoia ruau di waimompa.
Tane bo bedewe enawisa umanawa dima God buka bedewe e dialena mai wisiaitapona, ba? Me ema epe wadi wadiase,
‘Ne ipa Abraam Godiwa, Aisak Godiwa ita Iakob Godiwa.’ Insenadewaitana, me mai bolala Godiu, dia, tane me ipa mo wanwankasalala Godiu.”
Apana uara ema etane ita Iesu waeuwawa mampe memesanton.
Anaana dainea debamawaida?
Iesu Sadusi apanawa sipoadewasamodio mo mai dima da wapona rua. Ita ema umanawa Parisi apanawa etane auwenatue Iesu mampe anton.
Tane mo bedeuwo anaana waeuwalala dea menasadia Iesu waitara mampe rubusapi, sa baiwa me diene wanase,
“Debamamba, anaana dainea debamawaida uduudu bedeuwo?”
Iesu leusane wanase, “E Tataa God nuaa uduudu, insaisaa uduudu, atena uduudu, ita do mukaa uduudu mampe nuawadawadasane wanempa.
Anaana ema dea debamawaida uduudu bedeuwo.
Tane da deawaa debamawaida: ‘Sosoa nuawadawadamona eba nuawadawadaitiana rua.’
Moses anaanawa ita peroweta waeuwau uduudu anaana ema nata bedewentoiena.”
Keriso mida otopa?
Parisi apanawa isiwa sape auweiena Iesu waitaramone wanase,
“E Keriso mida God sauawalen baiwa ambi inseilana, me mida otopa?” Mo sipoasane waienase, “Keriso ipa Dawid atanosiwa.”
Ita Iesu mo waitaramone wanase, “Tane dima baiwa Aleu kakaiwa Dawid insaisawa waneno Keriso ebowa Tatana wan? Dawid ema epe wane wanase,

content.text: ‘Tatamba God ne Tatana mampe wane wanase, ‘Witana on deneuwe aisite wana ne ideita e wenawenaa nanausimope e waa atowe teamopatuwapi.”

content: Dawid Keriso ebowa wadi wadiase, ‘Tatana,’ tane ambi Keriso ipa Dawid atanosiwa?”
Mai mida da Iesu sipoasapona rua, dia. Tane ema aupe apana Iesu waitarawa santoiena.
